ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are glad to hear that you are enjoying your new grill!  The warming rack is positioned far back to maximize your grilling space; however, we do not expect it to come off easily. We will share this with our developing team. When grilling, please allow your grill to preheat with the lid closed for 15-20 minutes before adjusting the control knobs to the desired temperature. This will help regulate the heating throughout your grilling surface area! A generous warranty backs your grill, and we do not expect to see rusting prematurely. Please remove the grates and clean them using warm water and nonabrasive soap. If it persists or worsens, don't hesitate to get in touch with us directly. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
Overall it's a very solidly-built grill, and heats up really fast to high temperatures. I like the folding side tray, which keeps it compact when covered, as well. There are a few cons, however:
1) The warming tray is somewhat loose and can easily be knocked out of place. It also makes it hard to reach the back of the main grill area.
2) While the grill heats up well, there are still some hot and cold spots. The front area, especially in the corners, does not heat up as well as the back and middle.
3) The "enameled cast iron" grill top is nice for cooking, but with 1 or 2 uses it's already showing lots of rust when cleaning with a weber grill brush. I dunno that I'd call this "enameled."
Results.Title: Good, but not great.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
